title: Chapter 341 Reorganization
content:
Chapter 341 Reorganization

The leaders of the people in the two countries are still lucky, because they are greedy for the power they own, and they are unwilling to give up everything and become an insignificant ordinary citizen.

Therefore, their recruitment to the dojo, except for a small number of leaders of the people who really longed for an official status, accepted the recruitment very cooperatively.

There are still a large number of people who are not reconciled, that is, they are reduced to a low-level generation, holding the idea that they would rather be chicken heads than phoenix tails, and still stubbornly stick to each other, unite with those local tyrants, and resist the invasion of the dojo.

The active participation of these Chinese people in the battlefield has greatly increased the resistance of the local tyrants, making the pace of unification of the two countries even slower.

Out of this situation, the dojo changed the order again, targeting the leader's refusal to surrender, according to the thinking that the people at the bottom may not be unwilling.

Send all kinds of ninjas and spies wantonly, let them go in and out of the various forces of the people of the country, and stir up the dissatisfaction of ordinary people with the leader from the bottom.

Taking advantage of the desire of the Chinese people to restore their status as civilians, and even to join the army, and use their military exploits to obtain the status of a warrior, to drive a gap between the people of the country and the leader.

Things work out.

Many people were originally dissatisfied with the leader's actions, and gave up the civilian life they yearned for, disregarding their own lives, and wanted to block the attack.

It has completely aroused the anger of many ordinary people.

Then at a certain time, the Chinese who already had other plans in their hearts killed the unsuspecting leader.

Then in one fell swoop, he called on other Chinese to join his ranks and follow him to the dojo, so as to obtain a legitimate identity.

This kind of thing quickly swept away, like an unstoppable storm, sweeping across all the people in the country in an instant.

This storm not only caused many Chinese people to voluntarily go down the mountain and surrender, but also gave the dojo a large amount of usable cannon fodder.

It also affected many local tyrants.

These local tyrants were extremely reluctant to block the attack of the dojo, and it can even be said that there is a crisis of destruction at any time.

Under such circumstances, any slight supplement of power is extremely important to these local tyrants who are already on the verge of extinction, just like a life-saving straw.

So when those Chinese completely broke with the dojo, they took the initiative to join the camp that resisted the dojo, which gave the dojo a great setback in the pace of attack.

These local tyrants who have been lingering for a long time seem to see a hope, a hope for themselves to survive.

So they invited 10,000 bandits who they despised and hated from the bottom of their hearts to come to their castle to help them defend the dojo from the attack.

And these actions also laid the groundwork for the future destruction of these local tyrants.

Those who really want to resist the dojo's attack are only the few leaders. The vast majority of ordinary people in the country are quite resistant and disgusted with those local tyrants, and there is a great contradiction between the two.

This is a class conflict, and even with a little personal hatred, it is extremely difficult to mediate.

Now relying on the oppression of the leader and the prestige of the previous leader, these ordinary people can barely obey orders and help these local tyrants resist the attack.

But now there is active contact from the dojo, and they have sent ninja spies and other secret forces to encourage them. All of a sudden, the dissatisfaction that had been hidden in their hearts burst out in an instant.

Those Chinese people who were only in the mountains and forests, relying on the low terrain to block the threat of the dojo, were a little better, but after killing their leader, they packed their bags and went down the mountain to accept the reorganization.

But those Chinese people who have already settled in the local rich castle are not so simple.

Not only did they kill their own leaders, but they also took advantage of the unsuspecting opportunity of those local tyrants to turn against them and deal a fatal blow to those local tyrants.

If the people of the country are stronger than those local tyrants, they will directly attack the castle tower of the local tyrants and kill those local tyrants' family governors (equivalent to the family heads). Then the remaining old and weak women and children will have to bear the ravages of bandits without the slightest moral discipline.

If the people of the country are weaker, they should contact the army of the dojo outside, and agree with them on the time mark, when the time comes, they should cooperate with each other, open the city gate together, and let the army of the dojo enter the city.

After such an action, the result was exceptionally remarkable.

Not only has almost all the people of the country been truly incorporated, but even most of the local local tyrants who are resisting have also suffered.

The originally relatively solid defense suddenly had great flaws and hidden dangers, and then the dojo army seized the opportunity to attack quickly, and it was wiped out along with it.

After such a thorough sorting out, not only almost all the people in the Three Kingdoms were collected and wiped out, but all the hidden dangers in the country were completely eliminated, at least all the hidden dangers that could be detected on the surface, so that the territory in the Three Kingdoms was completely stable. down.

Moreover, in the remaining two countries, there are still some original forces, and the local tyrants who are barely resisting the dojo army also suffer together.

These local tyrants were originally weak and difficult to resist, so almost two-thirds of the remaining local tyrants accepted the support of those bandits and brought them into the castle.

And when those bandits rebelled, they also suffered.

Almost all the castles of the bandits who took in could not escape the fate of being breached by the dojo army, and the cities were destroyed one after another, and the entire family was completely expelled.

Without the pressure sharing of these allies, the remaining small group of local tyrants is even more difficult to resist.

After the dojo wiped out most of the resistance, more abundant troops were mobilized under their city, which suddenly increased their pressure.

It was almost impossible to withstand it for a few days, and it was also impossible for those descendants of perishing families to perish.

Therefore, after Zhong Yu formulated the policy of recruiting bandits, within about a month, all the bandits were recruited, and even the remaining resistance of the family was completely shattered.

The entire Three Kingdoms has truly entered into a unified system, and the people of the Three Kingdoms have also ushered in a new era, which belongs to the era of dojo rule.

The dojo, after integrating the power of the remaining local tyrants and incorporating bandits, ushered in another explosion of strength.

Among them, the strength of the second-tier warriors has not increased much, and it is still about 20,000 people.

After all, to be able to reach the second level, they are either the direct clansmen of some local tyrants, or the leaders of those bandits.

Both of them are hostile to the dojo, and have irreconcilable conflicts of interest, so it is naturally impossible to take refuge in the dojo.

However, the strength of the first-tier regular legion has been praised from the original 50,000 to about 80,000 in one fell swoop, and its strength has increased by more than half.

And the legion that has not reached the first level, but has a certain strength, after incorporating bandits and some civilians recruited in the Three Kingdoms during this period, the scale has reached 100,000.

In the whole of the Three Kingdoms, there are already 200,000 legions with formal establishments, which is almost equivalent to 1/9 of the total population.

With such a powerful force, and at the same time sweeping away all hidden obstacles in the country, Zhong Yu can finally fulfill his ambition.

Leading the army to the west, eradicating all the princes in the whole world in one fell swoop, and unifying the ambition of the Japanese world.
